text:
jake_support: FYI -- just escalated a P1 activation for 'VeritasHealth'. SSO failing, users see 403 at token exchange. Customer is on a pilot with renewal in 6 weeks, asking for an activation window tomorrow.

maria_csm: ack. thanks for the raise. can you paste the error snippet and which env (prod/stage)?

jake_support: prod. error log: `oauth: token exchange failed status=403 body=\"forbidden: invalid assertion\"` — looks like assertion audience mismatch after last week's key rotation. Repro on our side when using their SAML assertion.

lee_se: tagging this for infra review. @ops-bot can you pull the last key rotation commit and timestamp for prod auth-service?

ops-bot: commit 9a3f7c rotated keys on 2026-03-10T04:12:23Z. Related PR: https://git.internal/redwood/auth-service/pull/462

maria_csm: OK — immediate ask: (1) can we try rolling back the rotation to verify, (2) prepare a clear comms snippet for the customer, and (3) schedule an enablement session timeline. Jake, can you own the customer-facing note? Lee, ops please triage rollback test. Emily, I'll own the renewal risk comms to AMs.

jake_support: I can draft the note. Suggested short: "We're investigating an authentication mismatch; a mitigation step may require a brief config update. We'll confirm ETA within 2 hours." Should I include a temporary workaround: ask them to re-issue assertion with audience `https://api.redwood.ai/v1/saml`?

lee_se: we should avoid asking customers to re-issue certs if possible. Ops will try a controlled rollback in staging first, then a fast rollback in prod if it repros. ETA 45m for staging test.

emily_csm: For AMs: highlight pilot at renewal risk, recommend a proactive checkpoint with account exec. I'll draft a short internal note after we confirm ETA.

maria_csm: Good. Also prepare a short comms plan we can send to the customer + internal stakeholders: 1) acknowledgement + impact, 2) mitigation steps we are taking, 3) expected ETA, 4) escalation contacts, 5) ask from customer (if any). Keep language non-technical for execs.

jake_support: Drafting now — copy for customer: "Hi <Name>, we're investigating an authentication error affecting SSO logins. We're running a targeted test and expect a remediation or temporary workaround within 2 hours. We'll update you at T+2 and again when resolved. Apologies for the disruption; we'll share a root cause and preventive steps after." Thoughts?

maria_csm: clean. Add: "If you need immediate access, we can temporarily create scoped API keys for your integration test users — please let us know which emails."

lee_se: ops test result: staging rollback reproduced login success. Prod rollback will clear by applying previous key version to auth-service; prepping a short outage window of ~2 minutes. Ops requests approval to perform rollback now.

emily_csm: Approve from CS side for a 2m window. I'll ping AM and let customer know expected brief interruption.

jake_support: Rolling back now. I'll update here when prod back to green.

ops-bot: deploy rollback job started at 2026-03-11T15:22:03Z, job id 74421

jake_support: Prod back to green, SSO tests passing. Confirmed with customer on a quick call — they validated SSO success.

maria_csm: Awesome. Next steps: 1) schedule a postmortem with infra & support within 48h, 2) prepare a one-pager for AMs outlining impact + mitigation + next steps, 3) capture feedback from customer on how we communicate (Emily will lead). Assigning owners: postmortem=lee_se, AM one-pager=emily_csm, root-cause writeup=jake_support.

emily_csm: I'll draft AM one-pager and an email template for renewal execs. Also adding a CS playbook entry: quick-checklist for SSO-themed activations (verify audience, key version, test assertion).

maria_csm: Perfect. Please add the checklist to our enablement repo: `docs/onboarding/playbooks/sso-activation.md` and link to runbook.

lee_se: will own postmortem and update runbook with exact rollback command and validation steps.

jake_support: capturing notes & will open a ticket for follow-up QA with the model cert rotation process.

maria_csm: closing action items in this thread. Emily — once you have the AM note, please @me and I'll help tailor for the renewal narrative. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

emily_csm: will do.

jake_support: ticket created: CSUP-8812 "VeritasHealth SSO 403 on token exchange" with links to logs and rollback job.

maria_csm: thread resolved. Marking as handoff -> postmortem queue.
